params.name: data
params.description: Optional. Data for populating the Message object.

params.name: data.info_types
params.description: Restricts what info_types to look for. The values must correspond to InfoType values returned by ListInfoTypes or listed at https://cloud.google.com/dlp/docs/infotypes-reference. When no InfoTypes or CustomInfoTypes are specified in a request, the system may automatically choose what detectors to run. By default this may be all types, but may change over time as detectors are updated. If you need precise control and predictability as to what detectors are run you should specify specific InfoTypes listed in the reference, otherwise a default list will be used, which may change over time.

params.name: data.min_likelihood
params.description: Only returns findings equal or above this threshold. The default is POSSIBLE. See https://cloud.google.com/dlp/docs/likelihood to learn more.

params.name: data.limits
params.description: Configuration to control the number of findings returned.

params.name: data.include_quote
params.description: When true, a contextual quote from the data that triggered a finding is included in the response; see Finding.quote.

params.name: data.exclude_info_types
params.description: When true, excludes type information of the findings.

params.name: data.custom_info_types
params.description: CustomInfoTypes provided by the user. See https://cloud.google.com/dlp/docs/creating-custom-infotypes to learn more.

params.name: data.content_options
params.description: List of options defining data content to scan. If empty, text, images, and other content will be included.

params.name: data.rule_set
params.description: Set of rules to apply to the findings for this InspectConfig. Exclusion rules, contained in the set are executed in the end, other rules are executed in the order they are specified for each info type.
